description: Use when an agent needs today's central bank rates for loans, savings, valuation or macro answers: ECB key rates (deposit facility, main refinancing, marginal lending, with the date they took effect) and US Fed funds target range, effective fed funds rate (EFFR) and SOFR from the New York Fed. Official sources only, named in every answer. region=EA, US or all (default). Bad input: HTTP 400 before payment; outage is not charged. Price: 0.002 USDC per successful call (x402).

region.description: EA (euro area / ECB), US (Federal Reserve) or all. Default: all.
